[1/4] Plan: v0.20 visual juice pass - biome ambience particles, shaped combat particles (spark/smoke/shard/ring/flash), muzzle and bullet glow, dash afterimages, low-health danger vignette, skill/relic card glyphs and animated button hover

impact_assessment.why: The v0.19 pass fixed seams, hazards and layout, but screenshots still show flat biome atmosphere, one-note circular particles, a sparse level-up/relic card interior, no dash trail, and no persistent low-health warning; the game needs another visual layer that reinforces map identity and combat feedback
impact_assessment.benefits: Distinct desert/frost/ash/jungle atmosphere, readable shot/hit/death/pickup feedback, stronger skill and relic identity on choice cards, a clear dash trail and danger state, all procedural and within the existing draw budgets
impact_assessment.risks: contract: particle objects and render helpers change, snapshot gains read-only particles/afterimages/ambience data, no save-schema or mechanics change; dependency: none; concurrency: ledger shared; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Cap every particle family, keep ambience screen-space and deterministic, reuse cached canvases for danger glow, add particle-kind and afterimage tests, rerun the full suite and draw budgets, compare fresh screenshots, then run python aikit.py check dustline

checkpoints.description: [2/4] Particle and effect layer complete: deterministic biome ambience for all four maps, shape-coded particle kinds (dot/spark/smoke/shard/ring/flash/glow) with additive highlights, muzzle flash and glowing bullet trails, impact sparks, shard/smoke deaths, explosion rings, dash afterimages and a cached low-health red vignette plus pulsing border; new cosmetic bursts use a separate run-seeded fx RNG so the gameplay RNG stream stays unchanged

[3/4] UI and card graphics complete: procedural skill glyphs on level-up cards and the codex, relic glyphs on salvage cards, animated hover pulse/glow on buttons, spread floaters with a text shadow, README and package 0.20.0 updated, ADR-020 recorded; 121/121 tests pass

[4/4] Verification complete: 121/121 tests pass, python aikit.py check dustline reports 5/5 gates, fresh canvas captures and the v0.20 contact sheet confirm hover glow, codex/level-up/relic glyphs, all four biome ambience modes, dash afterimages, low-health warning and shaped explosion particles; particle cap and 7,000-op budgets hold; checklists: passed
Task 'dustline-v0-20' completed successfully.
[1/4] Plan: v0.21 world graphics pass - per-map ground decor, layered trees, shaded rocks and lit building windows, fading scorch decals, player rim/overdrive and boss ground auras

impact_assessment.why: After v0.20 the atmosphere and combat feedback read well, but screenshots still showed empty ground between props, flat trees and rocks, unlit window holes, explosions that vanished without a trace, and weak player/boss presence against the terrain
impact_assessment.benefits: Each map gets a distinct ground-detail identity, props gain depth and inhabited details, explosions leave spatial history, and the player and bosses read more clearly without changing gameplay
impact_assessment.risks: contract: render helpers gain non-solid decor and decal state, snapshot gains a read-only decals count, no save schema or mechanics change; dependency: none; concurrency: ledger shared; state: decals capped and transient
impact_assessment.mitigation: Place decor by hash so the seeded gameplay stream is unchanged, keep decor non-solid, cap and fade decals, test per-map decor kinds and decal lifecycle, rerun the full suite and draw budgets, capture fresh screenshots, then run python aikit.py check dustline

checkpoints.description: [2/4] Map decor complete: deterministic non-solid 210px decor fields with desert grass/bones/pebbles, frost snowgrass/ice/pebbles, ash charred stumps/bones/ember cracks, and jungle ferns/flowers/mushrooms; each cluster has wind sway and is drawn under props/entities
